guidelines: Days are numbered from 1; map day 1 to any start date chosen by the user.
The first treadmill minutes are a warm-up. Allow recovery/transition within each strength/core block.
If machine changes take longer than planned, shorten cardio by a few minutes instead of rushing sets.
Use a light resistance that allows controlled, pain-free repetitions; gradually increase load only if comfortable.
Choose brisk walking instead of jogging if running causes back discomfort.
Low row means a supported/upright low row machine. Do not use bent-over unsupported rows with back pain.
Stop an exercise that worsens back pain. If pain radiates to the leg or persists, get medical assessment.
Core exercises do not selectively reduce belly fat; nutritional habits and overall activity matter.
A 20-minute walk on rest day is optional and not counted as a gym workout.

treadmill_walk_jog.name: Treadmill - brisk walk / light jog
treadmill_walk_jog.instructions: Brisk walk for first 3 minutes, then jog gently or continue brisk walking for 7 minutes. Use talk-test moderate effort.
treadmill_walk_jog.back_safety: Prefer brisk walking instead of jogging if running aggravates your lower back.

video_player_policy.time_budget: Tutorial viewing time is outside the prescribed 30-minute workout time. Pause the session timer while video is open.
video_player_policy.first_time_behavior: Offer tutorial automatically on the first encounter with an exercise; users can dismiss and choose not to auto-show it again.
video_player_policy.replays: Watch tutorial and replay available from each exercise card in all sessions.
video_player_policy.failure_fallback: Show written instructions and an external open-video link if embed is blocked, missing or offline.
video_player_policy.rights: Embed only if the source allows it. Do not download, copy, or rehost source videos without the owner’s permission.
video_player_policy.machine_match: The low-row and leg-press machines can vary; require equipment match and allow substitute demos.
video_player_policy.review_policy: Links found on public pages; a clinician or trainer has not reviewed each video against the user’s gym equipment.
video_player_policy.offline: Written cues remain available offline. Videos may require connectivity.
video_player_policy.notification: Daily reminder shows today’s workout; only start within-workout transitions after the user taps Start.
